issue.title: System Phase1-3 P-A: Knowledge typed delivery and fixed-byte binding engineering assignment

acceptance_criteria.verbatim: 現行Knowledge input/handoffがHandoffv2予約型検出と衝突し配送不可な問題を解消。ArtifactDeliveryの明示minor version(推奨1.1)でknowledge-input-v1/knowledge-handoff-v1/knowledge-context-v1を導入。旧Delivery1.0/旧Handoff2.0/Knowledge1.0/Readiness1.0の意味・既存正常系を維持。
format/version/document_type/identity dispatchを厳格検証。genericJSON/text/Handoffへの降格偽装、未知/欠損/重複型、private_only、JSON重複/NaN/BOM/切詰め、path/URL/symlink/gitlink等既存防御を維持。

Knowledgeinput↔handoff間assignment/raw_findings/knowledge_references/task_id/attempt/retry_ofの一致、全findingの判断、adopted記事実体、source/context/articleの固定bytes/digest/locatorを機械照合。自由locatorだけを存在証明とせず全必要実体をbundleに含めfailclosed。既存schemaに無断追加fieldを押し込まない。引用された内容をAgentへの命令にしない。
manifest/publication/consumption/authorization schema版とCLI・docs・samplesを整合。承認scope/consumer/purpose/pinとreceiptの無権限性維持。旧版で新formatを静かに通さない。Readiness成功やIssueACに波及しない。
正常/異常回帰tests、旧107tests全成功、実固定GitのKnowledgefixture配送を独立Testが再現できる手順。データは公開済みexamplesまたは明示synthetic。Test/Reviewは別CloudでManager起動。
公開安全なコード/契約/文書/fixturesのDraftPR、固定head/CI/消費receipt/完全Handoff/検証証跡を出す。実運用非同期/周期成功はP-B/C/D未実施として残す。

summary: Independent P-A Test PASS at fixed head: 128 head and 107 base methods, 117 added cases, 45 checks, fresh Git consume/recheck. Public-alias minimal candidate only; original evidence preserved. Review, merge and IssueCompletion not claimed.

artifacts.summary: Pinned dependencies, fixture preparation, independent authorization boundary and all probe commands.

evidence.claim: Independent assigned P-A verification completed with reproducible expected/actual outcomes.
evidence.observation: All recorded checks passed; no blocking defect reproduced. See limits and readiness observations; no final_assessment.

ac_mapping.scope: Three Knowledge formats and legacy compatibility verified.
Strict dispatch, JSON, private-only, path/tree and type-confusion defenses verified.
Input/output equality, decision coverage and required source/article/context/retry bindings verified.
Version, approval and receipt boundaries plus schema/CLI consistency verified.
128 regressions, 107 baseline, 117 independent probes and fresh Git consume/recheck reproduced.
Draft exact-head PR/CI and sealed Test evidence verified; operational followups excluded.

completion_criteria: Independently verify supplied PA-1 through PA-6 at fixed head without product edits.
Return expected/actual/reproducers and honest limitations with complete Handoff v2.
Seal local evidence and candidate hashes; no publication or merge.
